name: array-with-empty-element
description: The three bytes `[,]` — an array whose first element is a stray comma. Not an object, so V4 rejects it.
notes: A regression guard for a denial of service, not just a shape check. V4's duplicate-key walk (D13) uses json.Decoder.More(), which reports whether the next byte is something other than `]` or `}` — so on a stray comma it keeps promising an element that Token() cannot deliver, and a walk that treats a token error as 'skip this one' never advances. Three bytes from an unauthenticated caller pinned a relay CPU indefinitely. ROJ-44's differential harness caught it before it shipped. If either codec regresses, this vector hangs its suite rather than failing it.
